svg.title: Orchard grower — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as orchard grower, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A broad apple with a short stem and leaf rises from a tapered fruit-picking basket. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
